interpretation: Numerical boundary correction and bounded held-out SUMO agreement supported. Dense randomized demand rejects the frozen equivalence criteria. Empirical forecasts are exploratory, not general validation.

content.purpose: Component verification and external-model agreement for single-lane car trajectories and protected junction flow. Provisional study-specific criteria; no general urban-traffic accuracy claim.
content.timeUnits: seconds for physical inputs and metrics; runtime ticks remain integers

convergence.claim: Report measured trends; do not assume monotone convergence for every metric.

acceptanceCriteria.scope: Provisional numerical-equivalence targets for these matched-model experiments; separate from regression invariants and empirical validity.
acceptanceCriteria.headwayDefinition: Consecutive first-road exit event times within the same green interval; report count and match by vehicle pair.
acceptanceCriteria.queueDefinition: Vehicles on the approach with speed below 0.1 m/s, sampled at equal times; this is the halted queue, not every vehicle slowed by congestion.

stochasticReplications.stochasticSource: Independent seeded demand headway perturbations, shared exactly by both simulators; driver dynamics remain deterministic.
stochasticReplications.inferenceUnit: Scenario realization, not vehicles or time samples.
stochasticReplications.pairedMeanCi: Student t interval over independent per-seed HTC-minus-SUMO scenario means; n=5 uses t(4)=2.776445105.

empiricalValidation.requirement: Use documented units, quality-control continuity and lane changes, separate initialization/calibration prefixes from prediction intervals, retain raw query/hash/license, and state environmental applicability. Field availability alone does not establish validation.

reportingRules: Retain every held-out result, including failures. Never widen thresholds after execution without a new protocol version and fresh validation set.
Freeze parameters before held-out execution. Store protocol SHA256 in each result.
Report signed bias, absolute error, distributions, coverage and invariant checks; do not align traces by fitted time shifts.
SUMO agreement does not substitute for empirical validation. Stochastic demand intervals do not quantify all epistemic uncertainty.
Separate wall-clock failures and unsupported scenarios from physical acceptance; retain and label all exclusions.

physicalFreeze: No physical dynamics or parameters were changed after first held-out execution. Only deterministic report reduction/units, CSV timestamp formatting and snapshot replay were corrected; every final case was rerun with the listed executable.

metricDefinitions.trajectory: Equal observed physical timestamps in the common trace interval; mean of per-vehicle RMSEs. Per-trip sample counts retained. Complete terminal durations are evaluated separately, including unequal arrival times.
metricDefinitions.percentile: Linear interpolation between adjacent ordered observations (type 7).
metricDefinitions.stochasticUnit: Independent demand realization; five paired scenario means. Driver dynamics deterministic.

protocol.scope: Exploratory isolated free-flow component forecast, not network traffic validation
protocol.candidateQuery: location='us-101' and v_class='2' and preceding='0' and local_y<500 and v_vel>20
protocol.selection: Chronological candidate time, then numeric vehicle ID; one candidate per vehicle/session. First three passing fixed quality checks, without examining model errors.
qualityChecks: Exact duplicate removal; reject conflicting records at the same subject/time.
111 contiguous 100 ms observations, increasing frame IDs and monotone longitudinal position.
Passenger car, unchanged lane, and no recorded preceding vehicle throughout the interval.
Finite nonnegative speeds and a positive speed fitted only from the first second.
protocol.initialization: Least-squares longitudinal speed from the first 11 positions (one second). Start forecast at the last prefix position with that speed as both initial and desired cruising speed.
protocol.model: Actual HTC MICRO Car on an isolated 1000 m link, 0.1 s clock and physics; no parameter fitting to forecast observations.
protocol.evaluation: Next 100 observed positions and speeds, excluding every initialization-prefix observation.
protocol.acceptance: Exploratory measurements only; no empirical acceptance threshold or broad validation claim.

limitations: Exploratory three-subject isolated free-flow forecast; no interaction, queue, junction or network validation.
No field-derived accuracy tolerance or global behavioral calibration.
NGSIM annotation/position inconsistencies are reported, not treated as exact ground truth.
Selection conditions on absence of a recorded leader and lane changes throughout the prediction interval.

fieldSnapshot.source: USDOT/FHWA NGSIM; exact raw bounded responses and metadata, plus derived quality-control/forecast inputs

excludedFromFinalExecutableAcceptance.reason: Development-stage executable, before the accounted-horizon/reporting follow-ups. Final scenarios were rerun.

Auxiliary TCP bind failed on 45410 despite engine completion. The harness correctly rejected the log. Identical physical inputs were retried at 24000 and the entire final campaign used ports below the OS ephemeral range.

Pre-reporting-fix executable. Full comparison exposed 13 summary rows differing only in floating reduction order for one held-out pair; stochastic parity also exposed reduction-order differences. Raw failures retained; final deterministic summaries and exact policy/layout comparisons were rerun.
Original observation acquisition and initial forecasts. The same hash-checked raw observations were replayed with the final executable; the source snapshot is retained in the repository.

remainingWork: Audit following/discharge dynamics using the now-diagnostic v1 stochastic cases; do not tune v1 thresholds. Validate a physical model revision against a new frozen protocol and fresh scenarios/seeds.
Study-specific empirical calibration and independent validation beyond initialized isolated cruising forecasts.
Fractional-clock adapters for Person/Bus/Subway/Bicycle/Motorcycle, MESO, routing feedback and model plugins; unsupported fractional-clock configurations fail startup.
Uncontrolled conflict priority, gap acceptance, multi-lane junctions and shared conflict-area blocking.
Saturated-capacity validation, broader demand/weather/site coverage and city-scale execution costs. Five demand seeds do not quantify all uncertainty.
